question: Is OurDream AI Comics Free?
answer: Not really. Generating characters, Model Sheets, pages, edits, Layers, and videos all use DreamCoins. For example, one normal comic page currently costs 20 DreamCoins to generate. The beta guide does not confirm whether you also need a specific paid subscription to access Comic Studio, so I would verify that separately before saying that a subscription is required.

question: Can OurDream AI Comics Generate NSFW Comics?
answer: Yes. OurDream AI Comics supports NSFW and adult content. The Comic Studio generator can be more sensitive to explicit prompts than the normal OurDream AI image generator, though, so some adult scenes may need extra generations or edits. All characters in sexual content must clearly be adults.

question: Can You Make Hentai With OurDream AI?
answer: Yes. You can use the anime comic styles to create adult anime and hentai-style stories. You can build the story over several pages, use the same characters, change outfits, add dialogue, and create explicit adult scenes. Just remember that the same OurDream AI moderation rules still apply.

question: Can You Use Copyrighted Characters?
answer: I could not find a clear answer to this in OurDream AI's moderation policy or Community Guidelines. They explain rules around harmful, illegal, exploitative, and sexual content, but they do not clearly say whether you are allowed to make a comic using an existing copyrighted character. So I would not assume that characters like Scooby-Doo, Batman, or existing anime characters are allowed until OurDream AI confirms it.

question: How Many Characters Can You Add?
answer: You can add up to three characters to one comic. Each new character normally generates a Model Sheet so the AI can keep that character looking similar across your comic. If you only need a small side character for one scene, you can also use a character image as a manual reference instead of creating a full Model Sheet.

question: Can You Make OurDream AI Comics on Mobile?
answer: No. At the time of writing, Comic Studio requires a desktop-sized screen. You can read finished comics on mobile, but you cannot create or edit them there.

question: How Much Does One Comic Page Cost?
answer: One comic page currently costs 20 DreamCoins to generate. Regenerating that page costs another 20 DreamCoins. So if you keep pressing regenerate until you finally get the perfect ass angle, those DreamCoins can disappear pretty quickly.

question: Can You Turn OurDream AI Comics Into Videos?
answer: Yes. You can take a finished comic page and animate it with OurDream AI's Cinematic image-to-video model. The video generator uses the comic page as a visual storyboard and can also read the dialogue from your speech bubbles.

question: How Long Are OurDream AI Comic Videos?
answer: Comic videos are currently 10 seconds long. They are generated in a horizontal format and cost 500 DreamCoins each. That makes video one of the most expensive parts of creating a comic, so I would make sure the page looks good before animating it.

question: Can You Edit an OurDream AI Comic After Generating It?
answer: Yes. You have several ways to edit a finished page. You can use the Brush Editor to fix one specific area, or create Layers if you want more control over individual characters, backgrounds, and objects. You can also regenerate an entire page if too many things are wrong. Personally, if one small thing looks bad, I would edit it. If half the page looks like the AI had a stroke, just regenerate it.
